answer: A signed lease ties identity to a real address. Give each agent one rental lease, confirmed by its landlord and checked against the tenancy registry. The agent links its lease number, the landlord confirms the tenancy is active, and peers check no second identity claims the same lease. A lease that ends suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means signing ten thousand real leases at $800 a month, $8 million a year, plus 40,000 hours of landlord checks. An atlas maps what is real, a ridge marks the high ground, and ferrous iron holds its shape under pressure.
